name: improve-unsafe-sibling-diagnostics
title: Improve sibling-loader diagnostic messages (_UnsafeSiblingPath wording)
description: Deferred follow-up from 0.64.3 fleet review (rwbp-coordinator PR #195, Copilot). _UnsafeSiblingPath now conflates missing-helper with unsafe/unsupported load (O_NOFOLLOW-unavailable, symlink, non-regular); 'helper is not installed' / 'missing source validator module' messages are imprecise for the unsafe cases. Also recovery schema-version mismatch error omits expected-vs-actual. Improve wording without weakening the fail-safe behavior. Candidate for 0.64.4.
creator: sdelmas
